The Great King of Tantras of the Direct Realization of the Mahāyāna Samādhi, the True Gathering of All Tathāgatas, Scroll Twenty-Five.
The Great King of Teachings on the Samādhi of Direct Realization of the Mahāyāna, Truly Encompassing All Tathāgatas, Spoken by the Buddha. Fascicle Twenty-Six.
Translated by the Tripitaka Master of the Western Heaven, Chao Feng Da Fu, Acting Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

Translated by the Dharma-transmitting Master, the Saṃgha-monk Śīladharma (Śihu), and others, by imperial decree. The Twenty-third Chapter, Part Three: The Section on the Vast Doctrine and Principles of the Appropriate Expedient Means for the Ritual Procedures of the True Gathering of All Tathāgatas. Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the doctrine and principles for the empowerment and accomplishment of all the families of Tathāgatas:
"First, the general exposition of the doctrine and principles for the empowerment and accomplishment of all Tathāgatas is stated in verse:
'The supreme mudrā of the Lord of the Vajra Realm, Bound according to the Dharma with a mind of sublime meditative equipoise, ...'"
Place them at the heart, forehead, throat, and the space between the brows; having placed them, one obtains the power of the Buddha’s empowerment.
This is the Dharma-gate of awakened wisdom spoken by the Buddha.
The instructional principle for the accomplishment of the empowerment of the Tathāgata family:
"The Sattvavajra Firm Seal, the Vajrasattva Samādhi—place it likewise upon the heart, forehead, throat, and crown; having placed it, one immediately attains the power of empowerment."
The *Vajrakulādhiṣṭhānasiddhinaya*: "By forming the Vajra Trailokyavijaya mudrā with a mind of sublime meditative equipoise according to the ritual,
and placing it upon the heart, forehead, throat, and crown, one instantly attains the power of universal empowerment."
"This is the Dharma-gate of the Vajra Honored One spoken by the Buddha.
Regarding the *tantra* of the empowerment and accomplishment of the Lotus Family:
'The firm seal of the Vajra Lotus is the samādhi of the Honored One Avalokiteśvara.'"
By placing [the seed-syllables] at the heart, forehead, throat, and crown of the head, one immediately attains the empowerment of the deity.
This is the Dharma-gate of Avalokiteśvara spoken by the Buddha.
The instructional principles for the accomplishment of the empowerment of the Ratna Family:

"Form the great seal-mudrā of the Vajraratna; through the samādhi of the Honored One Vajragarbha, place [the mudrā] at the heart, forehead, throat, and crown of the head, and one immediately attains the empowerment of the deity."
“This is the Dharma-gate of Vajragarbha spoken by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the instructional principles for the accomplishment of the empowerments of all families.
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the instructional principles for the accomplishment of the empowerment seals of all families:
First, the general teaching on the ritual principles for the accomplishment of the consecration mudrā of all Tathāgatas is stated as follows:
"Joining the two aspects of the Jewel-Vajra Mudrā, Place it according to the rite between the eyebrows;
By accomplishing this with the Vajra-Jewel, One immediately receives the consecration of the Buddha of one’s own family."
"This is the Dharma-gate of awakened wisdom taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the ritual principles for the accomplishment of the consecration mudrā of the Tathāgata family:
'All the Lords of the Vajra Realm and others, [are] the supreme Buddha-mudrās manifest before one.'"
The ritual of the four seals pervading the four directions: at every location, one binds the garland and performs the consecration.
Regarding the *Vajrakula-abhiṣeka-mudrā-siddhi-tantra*:
"One should fashion the Vajra-consecration garland; according to the ritual procedure, join it together and place it upon the forehead."
Through the cause of that consecration by the jewel garland, one immediately attains the rite of the Vajra consecration.
Regarding the ritual principles for the accomplishment of the mudrā of the Lotus Family consecration:
"Joining the two forms of the Dharma-Vajra mudrā, one should place it upon the crown of the head according to the instructions."
By means of this cause of the Buddhas’ consecration, one immediately attains the consecration of Avalokiteśvara.
This is the Dharma-gate of Avalokiteśvara taught by the Buddha.
The ritual principles for accomplishing the Consecration Mudrā of the Ratna Family:
One should bind the Vajraratnadaṃṣṭrā mudrā and, according to the ritual, place it between the eyebrows;
through this cause of the Buddhas' consecration, one immediately attains the supreme consecration of offering.
"The above constitutes the instructional principles for the accomplishment of the initiation mudrās of all families.
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the instructional principles for the accomplishment of the samādhis of all families:
"First, the general instructional principles for the accomplishment of the samādhis of all Tathāgatas are as follows:"

"All the characteristics of all Buddhas consist of binding mudrās with a mind in meditative equipoise (samādhi) and reciting mantras and vidyās according to the ritual; thus one will swiftly attain the supreme siddhi as appropriate."
"This is the Dharma-gate of awakening wisdom taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the *Tathāgatakula-samādhi-siddhi-tantra*:
'That samādhi-vajra dharma corresponds to the principle of the *sattva*-empowerment.'"
By reciting the heart-mantras and vidyās while maintaining the mudrās, one will swiftly achieve all that is to be accomplished.
This is the Dharma-gate of the Samādhi of Enlightened Wisdom taught by the Buddha.
The Vajra Family Samādhi Sādhana Scripture:

“The nature of desire gives birth to that wisdom-dharma; I should visualize myself as this wrathful deity, Holding the heart-seal and reciting all mantras and vidyās, And swiftly attain the accomplishment of all activities.”
"This is the Vajradhara Dharma-gate taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the *sādhana* instructions for the Lotus Family Samādhi:
'Practicing in accordance with the vast activity of a compassionate mind, one effects accomplishment within the center of the heart.'"
Within the family of the Honored One Avalokiteśvara, all recitations shall achieve the accomplishments of bestowal.
This is the Dharma-gate of Avalokiteśvara spoken by the Buddha.
The instructional principles for the accomplishment of the Samādhi of the Jewel Family:
"Visualize all the samādhis of desire with a mind in sublime equipoise;
by reciting the heart-mantras and vidyās, all goals shall be accomplished."
“This is the Dharma-gate of Ākāśagarbha spoken by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the instructional principles for the accomplishment of the samādhis of the various families.
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the instructional principles for the accomplishment of the offering mudrās of the various families:
"First, the general teaching on the ritual principles for the accomplishment of the offering mudrās of all Tathāgatas is as follows:
'Having properly performed the various offerings, such as incense and so forth, with a mind of sublime meditative equipoise (samādhi),
one will thereafter obtain the methods of siddhi for the gateway of desired accomplishments, according to one's wishes.'"
The *Tathāgatakula-pūjāmudrā-siddhi-tantra*:
"The fourfold methods of secret worship—this is taught as the gateway to the secret worship.
Whether offering one's own body and so forth, whatever worship is performed, all shall be accomplished."
"This is the Dharma-gate of Vajrasattva spoken by the Buddha.
Regarding the ritual principles for the accomplishment of the Vajra-family offering mudrā:
'The great offering of the Wrathful Vajra—this is taught as the secret method of wrath.'"
"When one performs [the ritual] everywhere with the wrathful fist, the dharma of my own family is swiftly accomplished.
This is the Dharani-vajra Dharma-gate taught by the Buddha.
"The Ritual for Accomplishing the Lotus Family Offering Mudrā: [as follows]"
"In the profound and vast sūtras, the secret methods of skillful means are proclaimed;
when offering the worship of speech and mind, one swiftly attains the accomplishment of the dharmas of one's own family."
"This is the Dharma-gate of the Vajra Eye spoken by the Buddha.
Regarding the ritual principles for the accomplishment of the offering mudrā of the Ratna family:
'With parasols, banners, pennants, and various musical instruments, one should perform great offerings with reverence and respect.'"
When attaining accomplishment within the Ratnakula, or further receiving those various offerings—
this is the Dharma-gate of Vajragarbha spoken by the Buddha.
Through the harmonious union of the empowerment of the *iṣṭadevatā* and so forth, one becomes non-different from Vajrasattva.
Through the four types of supernormal powers and the gateway of supreme wisdom, one accomplishes that vajra skillful activity.
This is the Dharma-gate of Vajrasattva taught by the Buddha.
"The above constitutes the ritual principles for the accomplishment of the offering mudrās of all families.
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the ritual principles for the accomplishment of the supernormal knowledge of all families:
"First, the general explanation of the ritual principles for the accomplishment of the supernormal knowledge of all Tathāgatas:"
“Samādhi is the Buddha within one’s own body; One’s own supernormal powers are the Honored Sugata.
When these are thoroughly and skillfully realized, The fruit of Bodhi is attained.”
The *Tathāgatakula-ṛddhijñānasiddhi-tantra*:
"All supernormal powers, such as the divine eye and others, Should be visualized with a mind in sublime meditative equipoise (*samādhi*);
The five types of supernormal powers will arise spontaneously, And one shall attain the state of the Honored Vajrasattva."
“This is the Dharma-gate of Vajrasattva spoken by the Buddha.
The *Tantra of the Accomplishment of the Wisdom of the Miraculous Powers of the Vajra Family*:
‘Once the miraculous power of wrathful wisdom has arisen, one should perform the accomplishment with a mind of sublime meditative equipoise.’”
The five kinds of supernatural powers arise spontaneously, and one immediately attains the method of supreme accomplishment.
This is the Vajradhara Dharma-gate taught by the Buddha.
The instructional principle for the accomplishment of the supernatural wisdom of the Lotus Family:
Once the supernormal power of craving for the Dharma has arisen, one should perform visualization with a mind in sublime meditative equipoise;
the five types of supernormal powers will arise spontaneously, and one shall immediately attain the accomplishment of the pure Dharma.
"This is the Dharma-gate of the Vajra Eye spoken by the Buddha.
Regarding the *Tantra of the Accomplishment of the Wisdom of the Jewel Family’s Supernatural Powers*:
'Once the wisdom of the supernatural powers has been generated through offerings, one should perform visualization with a mind in sublime meditative equipoise.'"
The five kinds of supernatural powers arise spontaneously, and one immediately attains the mastery of all *siddhis*.
This is the Vajradhara Dharma-gate taught by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the doctrine and principle for the accomplishment of the supernatural wisdom of all families.
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the instructional principles for the accomplishment of the Great Bodhi-wisdom of all families:
"First, the instructional principles for the accomplishment of the Great Bodhi-wisdom of all Tathāgatas are explained in general:
'The Vajrasattva Samādhi: Recollecting the noble deity of one's own family.'"
This gateway of great wisdom, the Bodhi of this Buddha, shall be accomplished through appropriate visualization and attainment.
This is the Dharma-gateway of awakened wisdom taught by this Buddha.
It is the instructional principle for the accomplishment of the Great Bodhi-wisdom of the Tathāgata Family.
"One should visualize all the great mudrās within the Vajrasattva-samādhi;
this is the gateway to the great wisdom of the Buddha’s bodhi, through which accomplishment is attained by visualizing accordingly."
"This is the Dharma-gate of the Great Bodhisattva taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the *Vajra-kula-mahābodhi-jñāna-siddhi-śāstra*:
'In the samādhi of the Great Wrathful King, one should form the *samaya-vijaya-mudrā*.'"
This gate of great wisdom, the Bodhi of this Buddha, shall be accomplished through appropriate contemplation and visualization.
This is the Vajradhara Dharma-gate taught by this Buddha.
The instructional principle for accomplishing the Great Bodhi-wisdom of the Lotus Family:
"In the samādhi of the Honored One Avalokiteśvara, one should perform the karma-mudrā and recite the mantra;
this is the gateway to the great wisdom of the Buddha’s bodhi—by visualizing it as appropriate, accomplishment shall be attained."
"This is the Dharma-gate of Avalokiteśvara spoken by the Buddha.
The *Sādhana-vidhi* for the Great Bodhicitta Wisdom of the Ratna Family:
'The Samādhi of the Vajragarbha Lord, with the Karman Mudrā well-performed.'"
This gateway of great wisdom of the Buddha’s bodhi—by observing and contemplating it as appropriate, one shall achieve accomplishment.
Thus concludes the instructional principle for the accomplishment of the Great Bodhi Wisdom of all families.
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the *tantra* of the accomplishment through devotion (*anurāga-siddhi*) for all families:
"First, the general *tantra* of the accomplishment through devotion for all Tathāgatas is as follows:
'For one who seeks the Buddha-bodhi for themselves, all purposes and benefits are universally accomplished.'"
If the dharma of the samādhi of buddha-recollection is accomplished, one immediately attains the love and joy of all Buddhas.
This is the Dharma-gate of Vajra-Love and Joy taught by this Buddha.
The *Tathāgatakulapriyāsiddhitantra*: "Once all objective spheres have been accomplished, Vajrasattva performs the accomplishment;
The reality that awakens is not in vain, And all that is desired is swiftly accomplished."
"This is the Dharma-gate of Vajrasattva spoken by the Buddha.
The *Vajrakula-anurāga-siddhi-tantra* states:
'Acting for great benefit according to the Buddha’s command, universally for the sake of subduing all who are evil.'"

"Purifying all sentient beings who harbor anger—this is the Vajra-Ānanda. This is the Dharma-gate of Trailokyavijaya spoken by the Buddha. The *Sādhana-naya* for the Lotus Family Ānanda: [The practitioner] should visualize himself as the Great Lord of the Lotus Family, the one who subdues all the world, possessing the splendor of a hundred moons. He is adorned with various ornaments, his body is white in color, and he possesses a wrathful countenance. With his right hand he holds a lotus, and with his left hand he makes the gesture of bestowing boons (*varada-mudrā*).

He is seated upon a lotus throne. Then, the practitioner should generate the mind of awakening (*bodhicitta*) and recite the mantra: *oṃ padma-hūṃ*. By reciting this mantra one hundred thousand times, one will attain the accomplishment of the Lotus Family Ānanda."
“Devotion to the Dharma is the contemplation of loving-kindness; compassionate mind is the speech of the True Dharma.
Bestowing fearlessness upon all sentient beings is what the Buddhas delight in.”
"This is the Dharma-gate of the Vajra Eye spoken by the Buddha.
Regarding the *ratnakula-anurāga-siddhi-tantra*:
'One should extensively bestow the rite of empowerment as appropriate, and grant various excellent treasures and stores.'"
They shall attain the benefits corresponding to Buddhahood; this is precisely what all Buddhas delight in.
This is the Dharma-gate of Ākāśagarbha spoken by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the doctrine and principle for the accomplishment of the Delight of the Various Families.
Furthermore, Vajrapāṇi Bodhisattva Mahāsattva proclaimed the ritual principles for the accomplishment of the *vaśīkaraṇa* (subjugation/love-making) of all families:
"First, the general ritual principles for the accomplishment of the *vaśīkaraṇa* of all Tathāgatas are as follows:
'One should know that the nature of desire is not to be shunned; it is likewise pure and a gift of bliss.'"
Benefiting all sentient beings in accordance with the Dharma—this is the principle of the Buddhas’ veneration and love.
This is the Dharma-gate of awakened wisdom taught by the Buddha.
It is the instructional principle for the accomplishment of veneration and love within the Tathāgata Family:
Desiring to practice in accordance with one’s own sublime bliss, one recites *sūradās tvaṃ*.
Through the gateway of the accomplishment of Vajrasattva, one truly awakens and performs acts of endearment.
“This is the Dharma-gate of Samantabhadra spoken by the Buddha.
The *Vajrakula-vaśyā-siddhi-tantra*:
‘The Buddha, for the sake of purifying all sentient beings, universally causes all beings to attain fearlessness.’”
"By means of Buddhist protection, all malevolent māras are slain and made to feel love and devotion.
This is the *Trailokyavijaya-tantra* taught by the Buddha.
The *Padmakula-vaśīkaraṇa-siddhi-naya*:
"Contemplate that the nature of desire is fundamentally pure, like a lotus flower in full bloom;
when there is passion or attachment therein, one should subdue it as appropriate and practice loving-kindness."
"This is the Dharma-gate of Avalokiteśvara spoken by the Buddha.
Regarding the *Ratnakula* teaching on the accomplishment of magnetizing (*vaśīkaraṇa*):
'In order to seek the empowerment (*abhiṣeka*) of all Buddhas, one should daily [offer] a great vajra-jewel.'"
By performing the rite of placing [the deity] between the brows, one immediately attains the principle of the love and respect of all Buddhas.
This is the Dharma-gate of Ākāśagarbha taught by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the instructional principle for the accomplishment of the love and respect of all families.
Furthermore, Vajrapāṇi Bodhisattva Mahāsattva proclaimed the principles for the accomplishment of subduing evil across all families:
"First, the general teaching on the principles for the accomplishment of subduing evil by all Tathāgatas is as follows:
'One does not perceive any sentient being who is to be benefited, nor is there any Buddha-nature that can be purified.'"
"Among the actions performed through body, speech, and mind, one shall attain the accomplishment of destroying evil dharmas.
This is the Dharma-gate of reality as taught by the Buddha.
The ritual principles for the accomplishment of destroying evil within the Tathāgata Family are as follows:"
"Through non-apprehension, all is accomplished; it arises from the absence of hatred and anger.
When this great vajra strikes, one swiftly attains the accomplishment of destroying evil dharmas."
“This is the Dharma-gate of the Vajra Hand taught by the Buddha.
The *Vajrakula-pāpavināśana-siddhi-tantra* states:
‘There is no evil to be restrained, nor is there any wrath; there is also no sentient being to be tamed.’”
"By bestowing one's own suffering upon others, one immediately subdues the Three Worlds and destroys all evils.
This is the Dharma-gate of Trailokyavijaya taught by the Buddha.
The instructional principle for the accomplishment of destroying evil within the Lotus Family is as follows:
"In the Dharma there is neither compassion nor loving-kindness; there are no wicked sentient beings to be purified.
Within speech that contradicts oneself, one spontaneously achieves the accomplishment of breaking through evil dharmas."
"This is the Dharma-gate of Avalokiteśvara spoken by the Buddha.
The *Sādhana-nyāya* for accomplishing the destruction of evil within the Ratna Family:
'One may give away one's own original wealth; one neither takes nor seeks the wealth of others.'"
"All sentient beings who are likewise impoverished shall themselves attain the accomplishment of the dharma that destroys evil.
This is the dharma-gate for fulfilling all aspirations taught by the Buddha."
"In harmony with the dharma of non-existence, I am not in union with the Buddhas;
yet for the sake of their rescue and benefit, may they swiftly grant me supreme accomplishment."
"This is the noble *Samantabhadra-dharmaparyāya* spoken by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the doctrinal principles for the accomplishment of destroying evil across all families (*kula*).
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the doctrinal principles for the accomplishment of the protective seals (*mudrā*) of all families:"
First, the general teaching on the ritual principles for the accomplishment of the seal (*mudrā*) of the empowerment of all Tathāgatas is as follows:
"Never forsaking any sentient being, I constantly make offerings to all Buddhas;
I take refuge in the Buddhas who are eternally honored— This empowerment is most supreme and rare."
The Ritual for the Accomplishment of the Seal of the Tathāgata Family’s Protection:
“The supreme name of Vajrasattva, If recited even once, it can bring about gathering [of blessings].
This protection is a vast gateway, Constantly bestowing accomplishment in an instant.”
"This is the Vajradhara Dharma-gate taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the ritual principles for accomplishing the protection seal of the Vajra Family:
'If one recites mantras and vidyās without a joyful mind, I am indeed the most supreme in the three realms.'"
By taking refuge in the holy deity Trailokyavijaya, one receives protection for oneself and others.
This is the Dharma-gate of Trailokyavijaya taught by the Buddha.
The ritual principles for the accomplishment of the protection mudrā of the Lotus Family:
"Purifying all desire through great compassion, constantly bestowing fearlessness upon all beings—
when the name of Avalokiteśvara is recited, this supreme and rare protection is granted."
"This is the Dharma-gate of the Vajra Dharma taught by this Buddha.
Regarding the *sādhana* of the Jewel Family’s Protection Seal:
'May the day’s activities not pass in vain; according to one's strength, cultivate the practice of skillful means.'"
"Constantly bestowing [offerings] upon the Buddhas and all sentient beings—this is the most supreme and rare protection.
This is the Dharma-gate of the Vajra Protection taught by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the ritual principles for the accomplishment of the empowerment seals (*mudrā*) of the various families.
At that time, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi addressed the Buddha, saying:
“World-Honored One!

I pray that the Buddha will accept these most supreme teachings on the accomplishment of all the families (*kula*) of all Tathāgatas, which I have just expounded, so that all sentient beings may realize mastery over the Dharma within all teachings and swiftly attain the fruit of Anuttara-samyak-saṃbodhi.”
At that time, the World-Honored One praised the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi, saying: "Excellent, excellent, Vajrapāṇi!"
"You have excellently expounded the aforementioned Dharma-gate; I now empower and sustain you.
Immediately, all the Tathāgatas again gathered like clouds and together praised the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi.
The verse says:
“Excellent is Vajrasattva; excellent is the Great Vajra Jewel!
Excellent is the Vajra Gate of Sublime Dharma; excellent is the Supreme Vajra Karma!”
One is able to skillfully proclaim this sublime Dharma, the unsurpassed Vajra Secret Vehicle,
the secret gateway of all Tathāgatas, which is subsumed within the Mahāyāna dharma of direct realization.
The Great King of Teachings on the Samādhi of Direct Realization of the Mahāyāna, Truly Subsuming All Tathāgatas, Spoken by the Buddha, Scroll Twenty-Six.
The Great King of Teachings on the Samādhi of Direct Realization of the Mahāyāna, Truly Subsuming All Tathāgatas, Spoken by the Buddha, Scroll Twenty-Seven.
Translated by the Tripitaka Master Śīladharma (Shi Hu), Dharma Master and Imperially Conferred Purple Robe, Preliminary Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, under the Imperial Edict.

Chapter Twenty-Four: The Section on the Vast Doctrine and Ritual Application of the Secret Methods for the Rite of the True Gathering of All Tathāgatas. Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the secret doctrine of the supreme accomplishment of all families:
"First, the general exposition of the secret doctrine of the supreme accomplishment of all Tathāgatas is stated in verse:"
"One should visualize the Buddha’s Great Bodhi Samādhi with a mind in sublime meditative equipoise;
by attaining that gateway to the wondrous bliss of bodhi, one achieves awakening through such contemplation."
"This is the Dharma-gate of all Tathāgatas as spoken by the Buddha.
Regarding the Secret Doctrine of the Supreme Accomplishment of the Tathāgata Family:
'Placing the Sattvavajra-mudrā at the heart, I, the virtuous beloved, am most deeply cherished.'"
When reciting *dṛḍhībhava*, one immediately attains the accomplishments (*siddhi*) of all Buddhas.
This secret method of union is such that those who do not attain accomplishment do so through the cause of their own karma.
When reciting *jugupsa*, one immediately attains the accomplishment of supreme bliss.
"This is the Dharma-gate of Vajrasattva spoken by the Buddha.
Regarding the secret teaching on the supreme accomplishment of the Vajra Family:
'Wherever anger arises, one should immediately form the mudrā of Trailokyavijaya.'"
"In this regard, when the secret wrathful one is accomplished, even all Buddhas give rise to fear.
This is the Dharma-gate of Trailokyavijaya taught by the Buddha, the Lord of All Tathāgatas.
The Secret Doctrine for the Supreme Accomplishment of the Lotus Family:
“Because the mudrās of samādhi are joined together, one should observe the vajra-fist as appropriate;
since oneself and others, as well as those who are dear and beloved, are all identical, one attains the accomplishment of the dharma of their love and delight.”
"This is the Dharma-gate of Padmaprīti spoken by the Buddha.
Regarding the Secret Doctrine of the Supreme Accomplishment of the Ratnakula:
'The union of the lotus and the vajra—this is said to be the supreme bliss.'"
Furthermore, one should offer [this] through the gate of one's own birth to all Buddhas for swift accomplishment.
This is the Dharma-gate of the Jewel-Love taught by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the secret teaching and principle of the supreme accomplishment of all families.
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the secret doctrinal principles for the accomplishment of the samādhis of all families:
"First, the general secret doctrinal principles for the accomplishment of the samādhis of all Tathāgatas are as follows:
'Recite *samayas tvaṃ*, and all who are well-loved will be filled with affection.'"
Without abandoning the mind that benefits sentient beings, one should always give rise to reverence and love for all Buddhas.
This is the Dharma-gate of Vairocana taught by this Buddha.
The Secret Doctrine for the Accomplishment of Samaya in the Tathāgata Family:
"One should know that the nature of desire is not to be abandoned; it is the means of winning the affection of all who are virtuous and lovely.
This is the gate of the Vajra Secret Samaya, which is the accomplishment of the protective dharma."
"This is the Dharma-gate of Vairocana spoken by the Buddha.
The Secret Doctrine for the Accomplishment of the Samaya of the Vajra Family:
'Though one may destroy the dharmas cherished by the world, one should find delight in all actions of body, speech, and mind.'"
The Door of Accomplishment in the Trailokyavijaya Rite: This samādhi can bestow accomplishment.
The Secret Doctrine for Accomplishing the Samādhi of the Lotus Family:
"Because desire is pure, I am pure; this purity is not the same as that of the external systems' reckoning of phenomena."
Now, through this gate of pure samādhi, one immediately attains the accomplishment of the well-guarded Dharma.
This is the Dharma-gate of Avalokiteśvara as taught by the Buddha.
The secret instructional principle for the accomplishment of samādhi in the Ratna Family:
"Form the Vajraratnamudrā as before; this is the Vajragarbha-samādhi.
To subdue and convert malevolent sentient beings, one shall attain accomplishment through this samaya-dharma."
"This is the Vajradhara-dharmamukha taught by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the secret doctrinal principles for the accomplishment of the samayas of all families.
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the secret doctrinal principles for the accomplishment of the dharmas of all families:
"First, the secret doctrine for the accomplishment of the Dharma of all Tathāgatas is explained in general:
'The self-nature of all phenomena is primordially pure; one should visualize this with a mind in sublime meditative equipoise.
By acting pervasively toward all things, one immediately attains the accomplishment of the wisdom of awakening.'"
"This is the Dharma-gate of the Vajradhātu taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the secret teaching on the accomplishment of the Tathāgata-family Dharma:
'All sentient beings follow their inclinations, yet they do not abandon any sensory objects.'"
Through the gate of purity regarding the beloved and the unbeloved, this secret dharma attains accomplishment.
This is the Vajra Secret Dharma Gate taught by the Buddha.
The Secret Doctrine for the Accomplishment of the Vajra Family Dharma:
"By visualizing the syllable HŪṂ at the tip of the nose, one can destroy all evil beings;
through this subtle vajra samādhi, one immediately attains the accomplishment of the appropriate dharma."
"This is the *HŪṂ* syllable dharma-gate taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the secret instructional principles for the accomplishment of the Lotus Family (*padmakula*) dharmas:
'By employing the sublime method of the subtle vajra, one gains the loving devotion of all who are virtuous and affectionate.'"
One attains all gateways of accomplishment and enters the *vajradharma-samādhi*.
Regarding the secret instructional principles for the accomplishment of the Dharma of the Ratna Family:
"By joining the lotus and the vajra, one is able to fulfill all aspirations."
Whether they be other lovers or consorts, all shall attain the method of supreme accomplishment.
"The above constitutes the secret doctrinal principles for the accomplishment of the dharmas of the various families."
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the secret doctrinal principles for the accomplishment of the rites (*karma*) of all families:
"First, the general explanation of the secret doctrinal principles for the accomplishment of the rites of all Tathāgatas:
'In the *vajrasattva-samādhi*, the practitioner constantly contemplates all Buddhas.'"
Entering the body of that beloved one as appropriate, one causes that virtuous lover to feel deep affection.
The Secret Doctrine for the Accomplishment of Rituals in the Tathāgata Family:
Just as with the *vajrasattva-samādhi*, one likewise enters her birth-gate.
Having entered, one expands [the visualization] within that body, until all beings are thoroughly brought to a state of reverence and love.
This is the Vajra-Love Dharma-gate taught by the Buddha.
The Secret Doctrine for the Accomplishment of Ritual Action (Karma) in the Vajra Family:

"Forming the supreme mudrā of Vajra Trailokyavijaya according to the rite with a mind of sublime samādhi, one enters the gate of birth as a wrathful deity; therein, one further generates the intent to destroy."
"This is the secret dharma-gate for the accomplishment of the Vajra Samādhi as taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the secret instructional principles for the accomplishment of the Karma of the Lotus Family:
'The mudrā formed through the ritual actions of the Dharma, the Vajra-Lotus Samādhi.'"
"Entering that gate of birth according to the Dharma, once entered, all who love [it] shall guard it well.
This is the Vajra Lotus Dharma-gate spoken by the Buddha.
The Secret Doctrine for the Accomplishment of Karma in the Ratna Family:
“Forming the Karma-Vajra-Ratna Mudrā, Abiding in the Vajra-Ratna Samādhi, One enters the birth-gate of all those who are enamored; In an instant, one can perform the act of awakening.”
"This is the Vajra-Jewel Dharma-gate taught by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the secret doctrinal principles for the accomplishment of the *karmas* of all families.
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the secret doctrinal principles for the pure accomplishment of the maṇḍala-cakras of all families:
"First, the secret teaching principle for the purification and accomplishment of the maṇḍala-wheel of all Tathāgatas is explained in general:

'The universal form of the pure Dharma-wheel; construct the outer maṇḍala according to the rite, surrounded by the vidyā-consorts and the assembly of mudrās; in its center, install the image of the Buddha.'"
Having entered therein according to the secret [teachings], one should, in an instant before that Buddha image, address the Exalted One:
"Grant me the accomplishment of the vidyā-queen which I seek."
The secret dharma thus explained is the principle of the mudrās of all families;
it can accomplish all secret attainments, for this is the peerless principle of all Buddhas.
“This is the Dharma-gate of awakening wisdom taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the secret instructional principles for the purification and accomplishment of all maṇḍalas of the Tathāgata family:
‘Draw the maṇḍala everywhere according to the ritual, its characteristics being like those of the Vajradhātu.’”
This is the supreme ritual procedure of the Tathāgata family, which is the supreme principle of all families.
Recite *siddhikāma* swiftly; having entered this maṇḍala, call out *samayasattva ho*. This is the initial accomplishment of Vajrasattva.
Recite this heart-mantra according to the ritual; all siddhis shall be accomplished.
Through the true awakening and the resonance with the Dharma, one swiftly attains the accomplishment of the joyful Dharma.
“This is the Dharma-gate of Vajrasattva spoken by the Buddha.
Regarding the secret teaching on the purification and accomplishment of all maṇḍalas of the Vajra Family:
‘The supreme form of Trailokyavijaya subsumes the entirety of the Vajra Family.’”
The wise one should draw all maṇḍala rituals according to the dharma.
Having entered therein, one should quickly proclaim: "I seek the secret method of accomplishment;
since this dharma is born from the nature of desire, may all such things be accomplished."
“This is the *Trailokyavijaya* dharma-gate taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the secret instructional principles for the purification and accomplishment of the *Padmakula* maṇḍala:
‘The ritual procedure for the supreme method of subduing the world is employed throughout all of the *Padmakula*.’”
The wise one draws this maṇḍala; having entered therein, he speaks these words:
"O Great Lotus of the Dharma of Passion, O Noble Lord, grant me swift accomplishment.
Having spoken thus, in accordance with the dharma, all maṇḍalas are accomplished.
"This is the Dharma-gate of Avalokiteśvara spoken by the Buddha.
Regarding the secret instructional principles for the purification and accomplishment of the Maṇḍala of the Ratna Family:
'By means of the supreme application of the Sarvārthasiddhi rite, one should draw the maṇḍala in accordance with this.'"
This is the practice corresponding to the Mahāratnakula; having entered therein, one speaks these words:
“Siddhi siddhi mahāsattva! Possessing all virtuous qualities, you accomplish all dharmas;
through the gateway of the siddhi of manifest love, may all supreme aspirations be fulfilled.”
Having thus uttered these secret words and entered into all the maṇḍalas, one attains the perfection of the methods for great siddhi; this secret offering is supreme and unsurpassed.
From this point onward, one will achieve self-perfection; all that is undertaken shall always be accomplished.
If this secret dharma is swiftly perfected, the true awakening shall likewise be achieved.
"This is the Dharma-gate of Vajrasattva spoken by the Buddha.
As above, this constitutes the secret teaching on the purification and accomplishment of the maṇḍalas of all families."
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the secret teachings for the accomplishment of the mudrās of all families:
"First, the general teaching on the secret accomplishment of the mudrās of all Tathāgatas:
'The Tathāgata is vast and most subtle; according to what is desired, he bestows all happiness.'"
True speech that accords with reality, Is not accomplished by those who harbor slander.
“The Secret Accomplishment Rite of the Great Mudrā of the Tathāgata Family:
One should bind the great mudrā of one’s own family, Following the sequence as it has been taught.”
This gateway of true secrecy was proclaimed from the vajra speech.
I am Vajrasattva himself; the Vajra Consort dwells within my heart.
When all parts of the body are joined together, one should courageously assume the posture of the exalted vajra.
The Vidyārājñī of the Exalted Vajra, truly awakening according to one’s desire, becomes firmly established within all bodies; as it has been taught, she swiftly brings accomplishment.
"This is the Dharma-gate of the Vajra Elevation taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the secret teaching on the accomplishment of the Samaya-mudrā of the Vajra Family:
'Siddhi siddhi and other samayas; samayāhaṃ, I delight.'"
Now, this gateway of swift awakening, Accomplishes all according to one's inclinations.
This is the Dharma-gateway of the Vajra Samādhi spoken by the Buddha.
The Secret Accomplishment Doctrine of the Dharma-mudrā of the Padma-kula:
“Mūṃ mūṃ, Great Sattva! You who are beloved by the virtuous ones of this family, this present gateway of swift awakening brings accomplishment according to one’s desires.”
“This is the Dharma-gate of the Vajra Dharma taught by this Buddha.
Regarding the secret teaching for the accomplishment of the Karma-mudrā of the Ratna Family:
‘The virtuous lover performs all karmas; I accomplish the Vajra of my own family.’”
Now, this gateway of swift awakening, according to one’s inclinations, brings about accomplishment accordingly.
This is the Dharma-gateway of Ākāśagarbha as taught by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the secret principles of accomplishment for the mudrās of all the families.
Furthermore, Vajrapāṇi Bodhisattva Mahāsattva proclaimed the secret teachings for the accomplishment of the samādhis of all families:
"First, the general teaching on the secret teachings for the accomplishment of the samādhis of all Tathāgatas is as follows:
'In order to benefit those who hold external views, the Buddha concealed the Dharma of skillful love.'"
"Simply by painting the mudrā according to the ritual, once this is fully understood, one achieves accomplishment.
This is the Dharma-gate of the Samādhi of All Tathāgatas as taught by the Buddha."
The *Tathāgatakula-samaya-guhya-siddhi-tantra*:
"Thoroughly knowing the minds of all sentient beings, Constantly bestowing happiness upon all sentient beings,
Acting as the venerable father to all sentient beings— This is the supreme desire and supreme samādhi of the Buddha."
“This is the Dharma-gate of all Tathāgatas spoken by this Buddha.
Now, these most secret and unprecedented teachings of all the Buddhas, the World-Honored Ones—
if one can understand them with pure faith, even those things difficult to accomplish will be achieved.”
"This is the Dharma-gate of Vajradhara spoken by the Buddha.
The *Vajrakula-samaya-guhya-siddhi-naya*:
'Those who find it difficult to be attached within the purity of desire, and those who cling to a self through heterodox and non-Buddhist views,' "
The supreme samādhi shatters that mind; having realized this, one attains accomplishment.
This is the Vajradhara Dharma-gate taught by the Buddha.
The Secret Accomplishment Teachings of the Lotus Family Samādhi:
“The great elements give birth to all things; therein, what is said to be pure?
When those of various heterodox views destroy appearances, the secret is definitively accomplished.”
"This is the Dharma-gate of the Vajra Eye spoken by the Buddha.
The Secret Accomplishment Doctrine of the Samādhi of the Jewel Family:
'The union of the excellent beloved jewels within the Jewel [Family], these jewels gather together in secret.'"
"This supreme gateway of the precious Jewel of Good Love shall be accomplished through observation as appropriate.
This is the Dharma-gate of Jñānakūṭa taught by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the instructional principle for the secret accomplishment of the samādhis of all families.
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the secret instructional principles for the offerings and accomplishments of all families:
"First, the general instructional principles for the secret accomplishment of offerings of all Tathāgatas are as follows:
'Surrounded by a multitude of virtuous lovers, one performs various delightful and sublime acts of love.'"
By making offerings and presenting gifts to the Buddha, the World-Honored One, one immediately attains the accomplishment of offering to the Dharma.
This is the Dharma-gate of awakened wisdom spoken by the Buddha.
It is the secret teaching on the accomplishment of offerings for the Tathāgata Family:
When one has rested after performing deeds of sublime joy, that supreme bliss arises from those joyful deeds;
by prostrating and making offerings at the four sites, one swiftly attains accomplishment by presenting them to all Buddhas.
"This is the firm dharma-gate taught by the Buddha.
The Secret Accomplishment Rite for the Vajra Family Offering:
'Binding the Trailokyavijaya Samādhi-mudrā, the sublime bliss of the union of the virtuous lovers arises.'"
"By means of that cause of harmonious and sublime bliss, one shall achieve accomplishment by making offerings to all Buddhas.
This is the Dharma-gate of Vajra Trailokyavijaya as taught by the Buddha.
*The Secret Accomplishment Doctrine for the Lotus Family Offering:* "Visualize yourself as becoming Avalokiteśvara,
And carefully observe the characteristics of the beloved object. Through that observation,
which is the cause of supreme bliss, One makes offerings to all Buddhas and swiftly attains accomplishment."
"This is the Dharma-gate of Lotus-Eye spoken by the Buddha.
Regarding the Secret Accomplishment Teachings for the Worship of the Jewel Family:
'Having formed the Karma-mudrā, one should adorn the body with all manner of ornaments.'"
"When one makes offerings through the union of excellent love, one attains accomplishment by making vast dedications.
This is the Vajra Jewel Dharma-gate taught by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the secret teaching on the ritual of offering for all families.
Furthermore, Vajrapāṇi Bodhisattva Mahāsattva proclaimed the doctrinal principles for the accomplishment of the supreme secret offerings of all the families (*kula*):
"First, the general teaching on the doctrinal principles for the accomplishment of the supreme secret offerings of all Tathāgatas:
'The secret dharma, which others hold dear and cherish, is such that no one is able to know it therein.'"
By visualizing according to the ritual method upon the body of the Buddha, one immediately attains the accomplishment of the offering rite.
This is the Dharma-gate of awakened wisdom taught by the Buddha.
This is the *Tathāgatakula-viśeṣa-rahasya-pūjā-siddhi-tantra* (The Secret Offering Accomplishment Teaching Principle of the Tathāgata Family):
"Perform the ritual of the Vajra-play of the marks; next, bind the sublime jewel garland of the vajra.
Utter the great vajra song and perform the vajra dance as an offering."
The sublime bliss of all desires is the supreme empowerment; within song, dance, and music, one finds the highest joy.
Beyond this, there is no other dharma-gate; secret offering is the most excellent.
The *Vajrakula-uttara-rahasya-pūjā-siddhi-tantra*:
"According to the ritual procedures for all phenomena as taught, the supreme offering is the secret offering;
by visualizing the noble deity Trailokyavijaya, one immediately attains the accomplishment of the offering rite."
"This is the Vajra Secret Dharma Gate taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the *Sādhana-vidhi* for the Supreme Secret Offering of the Lotus Family:
'The secret dharma as taught in the instructions, the sublime offering of the Great Dharma Mudrā.'"
By forming the mudrā that subdues the world, one immediately attains the accomplishment of the rite of offering.
This is the Dharma-gate of Avalokiteśvara spoken by the Buddha.
The instructional principle for the supreme secret offering accomplishment of the Ratna Family:
"According to the secret dharmas as taught, through the sublime offerings of the *karma-mudrā* and their correspondence with the *sarvārthasiddhi-dharma*,
one immediately attains the accomplishment of the offering dharma."
“This is the Dharma-gate of Vajragarbha spoken by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the instructional principles for the supreme secret offerings and accomplishments of all families.
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the instructional principles for the profound secret accomplishments that awaken the reality of all families:
"First, the general exposition of the profound and secret principles for the accomplishment of the realization of truth by all Tathāgatas is as follows:
'Arising from the wisdom of samādhi, The Buddhas-to-be appear in successive order;
Through the union with the Dharma cherished by the Sattvas, One swiftly attains the unsurpassed Dharma.'"
"This is the Dharma-gate of awakened wisdom taught by the Buddha.
It is the profound and secret teaching on the principles of accomplishment for realizing the truth within the Tathāgata Family:
'The *sattva* has neither beginning nor end; it is the characteristic of arising from space.'"
All are the body of Samantabhadra, The Lord of all worlds through sublime desire.
The mind of every sentient being— Its solid nature is itself sattva.
When united with the vajra, they are without distinction; They will certainly together achieve the nature of the vajra.
Having established the dharma of the sattva and completed it, one further becomes the venerable Vajrasattva;
this very body of the illustrious mahāsattva is Vajrasattva, the Tathāgata.
Having first awakened to one's own mind, one attains the Bodhi of a Buddha as taught;
that very Blessed One who has thus attained Buddhahood gives birth to all the Tathāgata families.
"This dharma-gate of the *sattva*, taught by the Buddha, is without beginning and without end.
From this, the Tathāgata family is established; it is likewise said to be the Vajra family, and the Pure Lotus family is formed in the same way; this is further called the Great Jewel family."
"This is the Dharma-gate of the Wheel of All Tathāgatas as taught by the Buddha.
As described above, this constitutes the profound and secret teaching for the realization of the truth of the various families."
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the secret instructional principles for the accomplishment of holding the insignia and seals of all families:
"First, the general secret instructional principles for the accomplishment of holding the insignia of all Tathāgatas are as follows:
'This very venerable Sattva resides within the heart of Vajrasattva.'"
The dharma-gate of the Samādhi of Union; this is that which brings about the awakening of Buddhahood.
This is the dharma-gate of awakened wisdom taught by the Buddha.
It is the secret teaching and principle for the accomplishment of holding the insignia of the Tathāgata family:
The vajra is the nature of perfect awakening; the supreme hook symbolizes the dharma of gathering and holding.
The arrow shoots toward the gateway of sublime wisdom that brings weary renunciation; excellent indeed is this sign of joy.
Exquisite jewels serve as ornaments; the solar disc is the mark that sustains radiance;
the jeweled banner signifies the gateway of establishment; and the mark of smiling is explained as great joy.
The lotus symbolizes the dharma of the purification of desire; the sharp sword cuts off those enemies that are the afflictions.
The Great Wheel has the dharma of its sphere as its cause; speech is the aspect of wondrous discourse and recitation.
The nature of the skillful activity of the various wondrous vajras is a suit of armor that protects well and cannot be destroyed;
like a tusk of an extremely fierce and terrifying form, the clenched fist represents the application of the mudrā method.
Just as the Dharma of the Buddha, the World-Honored One, is eternally abiding, and as the Vajrasattva pervades all conduct,
so too should one visualize this accomplishment through the gateway of the vajra and other emblems.
“This is the Dharma-gate of the insignia of all Tathāgatas as taught by the Buddha.
As described above, this is the secret doctrine for the accomplishment of holding the insignia of the mudrās of the various families.”
Furthermore, Vajrapāṇi Bodhisattva Mahāsattva proclaimed the secret instructional principles for the arising and accomplishment of the mudrās of all families:
"First, the general secret instructional principles for the arising and accomplishment of the mudrās of all Tathāgatas are as follows:
'Binding the vajra-paryaṅka posture, one should form the vajra-bandha with both hands.'"
Through the Vajrasattva Samādhi, one shall swiftly attain Buddhahood according to the Dharma.
This is the Dharma-gate of awakening wisdom taught by the Buddha.
The secret instructional principles for the arising and accomplishment of the mudrā-bindings of the Tathāgata Family:
"Just as the royal seal of the world, once impressed, becomes the king’s decree;
so too do the various secret seals of the Great Being universally impress all sentient beings, causing them to submit."
All the vajras of body, speech, and mind, The secret application of the supreme dharmas as reflected images,
And the gateways of the great seals (mahāmudrā) of all the Great Beings— Having realized these, one attains accomplishment.
“This is the Dharma-gate of Samantabhadra taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the secret teaching on the accomplishment of the arising of the mudrā-bindings of the Vajra Family:
‘Just as with those most excellent samādhi-mudrās, whichever ones are to be bound according to the occasion,’”
There is nothing that transcends this dharma-gate; so too is the dharma of all Tathāgatas.
The Buddhas and Vajrasattvas and others, through the supreme seal-mudrā and samaya-bond, must not be violated for as long as life endures; having understood this, one attains accomplishment.
"This is the Dharma-gate of the Vajra Samādhi spoken by the Buddha.
Regarding the secret teaching on the accomplishment of the arising of the mudrā-bindings of the Lotus Family:
'The vajra speech of all those Buddhas should not be transgressed according to the Dharma.'"
In this regard, if one knows this binding gate (*bandhana-mukha*), having known it, one immediately attains the accomplishment of the Dharma.
This is the Vajra Dharma Gate of the Dharma taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the secret instructional principle for the arising and accomplishment of the mudrā-bindings of the Ratna Family:
“The Great Karma of the Vajra Command—within this, there must be no transgression;
having fully understood this gateway of the command-karma, one attains accomplishment.”
“This is the firm Dharma-gate taught by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the secret instructional principle for the accomplishment of the arising of the mudrā-bindings of all families.
At that time, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi, endowed with virtue, addressed the Buddha, saying:
“Bhagavān! We pray that the Bhagavān will empower and sustain these various Dharma-gates which we have spoken.
Immediately, all the Tathāgatas gathered once more like clouds and together praised the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi, the supreme sovereign of all Tathāgatas.
The verse says:
“Excellent, O Vajrasattva! Excellent, O Great Vajraratna! Excellent, O Vajradharmamukha! Excellent, O Supreme Vajrakarma!”
One who can skillfully proclaim this sublime Dharma— the unsurpassed Vajra Secret Vehicle,
the secret gateway of all Tathāgatas— is subsumed within the Mahāyāna of direct realization.

Chapter Twenty-Five: The Section on the Most Secret and Vast Doctrine of the *Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṃgraha* Ritual Manual, Part One. At that time, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the doctrine for the accomplishment of the supreme dharmas of all families:
"First, the general teaching on the doctrine for the accomplishment of the supreme dharmas of all Tathāgatas:
'One should visualize all Buddha-dharmas samādhis with a mind in sublime meditative equipoise.'"
When one accords with the dharma of the *nien-fo* samādhi, one immediately attains the accomplishment of the unsurpassed dharma.
This is the dharma-gate of all Tathāgatas taught by the Buddha.
It is the instructional principle for the supreme accomplishment of the Tathāgata family:
"In the samādhi of Vajrasattva, one should visualize with a mind of sublime meditative equipoise;
through the dharma-correspondence of recollecting the nature of passion, one immediately attains the supreme accomplishment of the Dharma."
“This is the Dharma-gate of the Samādhi of all Tathāgatas as taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the *Vajrakula-uttamadharmasiddhi-tantra*:
‘In front of the supreme form of Trailokyavijaya, one should likewise perform visualization according to the ritual method.’”
"Through the power of Vajrapāṇi, one immediately attains the accomplishment of Trailokyavijaya.
This is the Dharma-gate of Vajrasattva taught by the Buddha."
The *Sādhana-vidhi for the Supreme Dharma of the Padma-kula*:
"Visualize the Noble Deity of the World-subduing Rite in front of you in this same manner—
fully endowed with all marks and exquisite ornaments— and perform all activities of subjugation."
“This is the Dharma-gate of the Vajra-dharma taught by this Buddha.
Regarding the *Sādhana-śāstra* for the Supreme Accomplishment of the Ratna Family:
‘The signs of accomplishing all aims and benefits are likewise to be visualized before one as previously described.’”
"Endowed with all marks and the dharma perfected, one immediately attains the possession of supreme wealth and jewels.
This is the Vajra-Hand Method taught by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the instructional principles for the accomplishment of the supreme dharmas of all families.
The Great King of Teachings on the Samādhi of Direct Realization of the Mahāyāna, Truly Encompassing All Tathāgatas, Spoken by the Buddha, Scroll Twenty-Seven.
The Great King of Teachings on the Samādhi of Direct Realization of the Mahāyāna, Truly Encompassing All Tathāgatas, Spoken by the Buddha, Scroll Twenty-Eight.

Translated by the Tripitaka Master Śīlagupta, Dharma-transmitting Master, Imperially Conferred Purple Robe, Court Gentleman for Ceremonial Service, Acting Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, and others, under imperial decree.

The Twenty-fifth Chapter, Continued: The Section on the Most Supreme Secret and Vast Doctrine of the Ritual Procedures for the True Gathering of All Tathāgatas. Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the doctrine for the accomplishment of the samādhi of the dharmas of all families:
"First, the general exposition of the doctrine for the accomplishment of the samādhi of the dharmas of all Tathāgatas is stated in verse:"
"When the Dharma of the Samādhi of Buddha-Recitation is accomplished, this is called the Vajra within the Vajras;
through union with the subtle and wondrous Vajra-dharma, one immediately attains the supreme accomplishment of Buddhahood."
“This is the Dharma-gate of awakening wisdom taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the ritual principles for the accomplishment of the Samādhi of the Tathāgata Family:
‘In the Vajrasattva-samādhi, one should visualize the subtle nature of the vajra.’”
"One attains the state of the Honored One Vajrasattva; therefore, he is called Vajrasattva.
This is the Dharma-gate of Vajrasattva taught by the Buddha.
The *Vajrakuladharmasamayasiddhinaya*: "Before the supreme form of Trailokyavijaya, one should likewise bring that deity to mind;
when reciting 'Hūṃ Hūṃ Hūṃ Hūṃ,' one immediately attains the unsurpassed dharma-siddhi."
"This is the Dharma-gate of Trailokyavijaya taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the *sādhana* principles for the accomplishment of the Samādhi of the Lotus Family Dharma:
'One should visualize all the signs of subduing the world as having the subtle nature of vajra.'"
When reciting "Jñāna, jñāna," one immediately attains the supreme accomplishment of the Dharma.
This is the Dharma-gate of the Vajra of the Dharma taught by the Buddha.
The instructional principle for the accomplishment of the Samādhi of the Dharma of the Ratnakula:
"The supreme sign of the accomplishment of all aims: Visualize the subtle vajra-nature;
When reciting 'Siddhi siddhi,' The highest benefit will be accomplished."
"This is the Dharma-gate of the Jewel of the Dharma taught by this Buddha.
The above constitutes the instructional principle for the accomplishment of the Samādhis of the Dharmas of all Families.
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the instructional principle for the accomplishment of the Wisdom of the Sublime Dharmas of all Families:
"First, the general teaching on the principle for accomplishing the wisdom of the sublime Dharma of all Tathāgatas is as follows:
'The sublime Dharma is primordially without letters; It is born from the wisdom of samādhi.
The various gates of phenomena and their characteristics— This is said to be the characteristic of non-arising.'"
Regarding the application of this method of secret mudrās, the wise one should perform visualization therein;
adorned with the wisdom of all syllables, one attains the fruit of the Sugata in a single instant.
"This is the Dharma-gate of the Wondrous Virtue of All Tathāgatas, as taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the *Tathāgatakula-saddharmajñānasiddhi-tantra*:
'If one wishes to know the reality of all Tathāgatas, One should maintain pure faith in this profound sūtra.'"
"When one upholds, recites, or gives rise to faith [in this], one attains the accomplishment of that unsurpassed Dharma.
This is the Dharma-gate of Vajrasattva spoken by the Buddha.
The *Vajrakula-saddharmajñānasiddhi-tantra*:
"For the sake of benefiting sentient beings burdened by sinful karma, one should properly perform what has been well-ordained by the Buddha’s command.
When the secret method for destroying evil is accomplished, all malevolent sentient beings will be thoroughly subdued."
"This is the Dharma-gate of the Vajra Family spoken by the Buddha.
Regarding the *Sādhana-śāstra* on the Wisdom of the Sublime Dharma of the Lotus Family:
'The intrinsic nature is primordially pure; this is declared to be the ultimate truth.'"
"In this regard, by contemplating that phenomena have no beginning, one swiftly attains the accomplishment of the nature of all dharmas.
This is the Dharma-gate of Avalokiteśvara spoken by the Buddha.
The *Ratnakula-saddharmajñānasiddhi-tantra* states:
"Extensively bestowing all material benefits upon sentient beings, Universally fulfilling all their aspirations— This is the ritual method of giving for the Ratna Family;
By visualizing it, one swiftly attains supreme accomplishment."
“This is the Dharma-gate of the Jewel of the Dharma taught by this Buddha.
The above constitutes the instructional principle for the accomplishment of the wisdom of the sublime Dharma of all families.
Furthermore, Vajrapāṇi Bodhisattva Mahāsattva proclaimed the instructional principle for the accomplishment of the samādhi-activities of all families:
This refers to the previously explained general teaching on the principles for the accomplishment of the *samādhi-karma* of all Tathāgatas:
"The *samādhi-karma* of the Buddhas is that which constitutes the awakening of Buddhahood;
when one contemplates this with focused intent, one immediately attains the supreme accomplishment of the Dharma."
"This is the Dharma-gate of awakening wisdom taught by the Buddha.
The *Tathāgatakula-samādhi-karmasiddhi-tantra*: 'The *Vajrasattva-samādhi* is itself the vast and supreme activity.'"
Skillfully performing deeds that benefit all sentient beings, one shall achieve accomplishment through meditative visualization herein.
This is the Vajra Dharma-gate spoken by the Buddha. The *Vajrakula-samādhi-karmasiddhi-tantra*:
"For the sake of universally purifying karmic offenses, I have become one who can destroy all sins;
Arising as the gateway for all sentient beings to shatter evil, Those who give rise to pure faith shall attain accomplishment."
"This is the Dharma-gate of the Vajra-Birth taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the *Sādhananaya* for the Accomplishment of Karma within the Lotus Family Samādhi:
'First, purify all one's own sins, and having extensively performed purification for all beings,..."
Thereafter, one should give rise to the various gates of *karma*; herein, through meditative visualization, accomplishment will be attained.
This is the Lotus Dharma-gate spoken by the Buddha.
Regarding the *Sādhananaya* for the accomplishment of the *Karma* of the Ratna-family Samādhi:
"May all that is sought by those who are destitute be entirely fulfilled according to their wishes;
may I accomplish every purpose for all beings, and herein there shall be no doubt of success."
"This is the Dharma-gate of the Vajraratnaketu taught by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the instructional principles for the accomplishment of the Samādhi-karma of the various families.
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the instructional principles for the accomplishment of the subtle wisdom of the various families:
This refers to the previously explained general teaching on the principles for accomplishing the subtle wisdom of all Tathāgatas:
“The subtle vajra-dharma is eternally abiding; All practices are performed according to the Dharma.
Within this, all signs are perfectly complete, And one immediately attains the five kinds of supernormal powers.”
"This is the Dharma-gate of awakened wisdom taught by the Buddha.
The *Tathāgatakula-sūkṣmajñāna-siddhi-tantra* states:
'Neither the ācārya nor the disciple, nor indeed any other practitioners.'"
"One should not reveal the gateway of secret mudrās, nor this secret method of accomplishment.
This is the Dharma-gate of Vajradhara spoken by the Buddha.
"The teaching on the principle for accomplishing the subtle wisdom of the Vajra Family:"
Through the application of the sublime method of the subtle vajra, In accordance with the practice of the syllable HŪṂ at the tip of the nose,
By means of the meditative absorption (samādhi) of Vajrakrodha, All that is undertaken shall be accomplished.
“This is the Vajra Dharma-gate spoken by the Buddha.
Regarding the *Sūkṣmajñānasiddhi-tantra* of the Lotus Family:
‘By employing the sublime rite of the subtle vajra, one should perform the vajra-gaze while maintaining the corresponding mudrā.’”
Through the samādhi-gate of the vast lotus, one immediately attains the accomplishment of the sublime rite of love.
This is the Lotus Rite of Sublime Love taught by the Buddha.
The *Ratnakula-sūkṣmajñāna-siddhi-tantra*:
"By employing the supreme method of the subtle vajra, gazing with a light that is most subtle,
through the gate of the vajra-mahāratna-samādhi, one attains the accomplishment of summoning all wealth."
"This is the Vajra Hand Method taught by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the instructional principles for the accomplishment of the subtle wisdom of all families.
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the instructional principles for the accomplishment of the eye-wisdom of all families:
"First, the general teaching on the ritual principles for accomplishing the eye-wisdom of all Tathāgatas is stated:
'Whether it be a mudrā or a samādhi, when conjoined with these two methods of accomplishment,
it is like the stainless purity of the realm of space, observing as the myriad stars shine brilliantly.'"
The wise one understands this well: "This very observation of mine is the Buddha-eye.
From this point forward, all ritual procedures of the Buddha Bhagavān shall be accomplished.
"This is the Dharma-gate of awakened wisdom taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the ritual principles for the accomplishment of the Eye-Wisdom of the Tathāgata Family:
'All those signs are non-existent; so too are the sentient beings and the vessel-world.'"
When those images arise, they are seen within the realm of space.
Whether the world appears to come or go, the vajra-eye perceives them all as utterly pure.
Having realized this, when one makes offerings, one immediately attains the accomplishment of the unsurpassed Dharma.
“This is the Dharma-gate of Vajrasattva spoken by the Buddha.
The *Vajrakulacakṣurjñānasiddhinaya*:
‘The eye of wisdom is seen within the expanse of space, rotating sequentially to the left and right.’”
Swiftly, within the expanse of space, one again sees them moving and dispersing like clouds;

yet having seen them, they possess no characteristic of movement or dispersion. Since the Wisdom-Seal (jñāna-mudrā) originally arises from the Vajra, when those various seals are held and bound, one immediately attains the accomplishment of the Wisdom-Seal Eye.
“This is the Vajra Dharma-gate taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the *Sādhana-śāstra* on the Wisdom-Eye of the Lotus Family:
‘Whatever black, white, red, and yellow [colors] there are—perceiving these as the signs of four-colored light-wheels,’"
Through the cause of that secret empowerment, one immediately attains the accomplishment of the Vajra Eye.
This is the Dharma-gate of Avalokiteśvara spoken by the Buddha.
The *Ratnakula-cakṣur-jñāna-siddhi-tantra*:
“In the midst of space, like the form of a jewel, Like those various precious treasures such as gold and the like,
When one perceives them within space, One immediately attains the accomplishment of the Space-Eye.”
“This is the Dharma-gate of Vajragarbha spoken by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the instructional principle for the accomplishment of the Eye-Wisdom of all families.
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the instructional principle for the accomplishment of the supreme activity (karma) of all families:
It is said that the general teaching on the ritual principles for the supreme *karma-siddhi* of all Tathāgatas is as follows:
"Through the ritual application of the *karma-maṇḍala*, one makes offerings to all Buddhas and noble deities;
the sublime joy of love brings the perfection of excellent retribution, and through union, one immediately attains the accomplishment of Buddhahood."
"This is the Dharma-gate of awakened wisdom taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the *Tathāgatakula-paramakarma-siddhi-tantra*:
'The secret offering is all-pervasive; one should visualize this my sublime love.'"
One attains the perfection of that supreme dharma and acquires the excellent majesty of Vajra-Love.
This is the supreme Dharma-gate of desire taught by the Buddha.
The *Vajrakula-uttama-karmasiddhi-tantra* states:
"Through the secret offering of universal activity, one should visualize this wrathful deity;
by attaining the perfection of that supreme dharma, one becomes no different from Trailokyavijaya."
"This is the Vajra Hand Method taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the *Sādhana-vidhi* for the Supreme Karma of the Lotus Family:
One should know that all sensual passions are pure; through the application of visualization and meditative concentration, one should contemplate with a focused mind."
This very gateway of the self-characteristic of union, through making offerings to the Buddha, brings about accomplishment.
This is the Dharma-gateway of Avalokiteśvara taught by the Buddha.
This is the *Ratnakula-parama-karma-siddhi-tantra*.
“With the vajra held aloft in union, prostrating with a heart struck by awe,
and constantly taking refuge in the Supreme Honored One, one immediately attains the sublime method of supreme empowerment.”
"This is the Dharma-gate of the Jewel Vajra Consecration taught by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the supreme ritual accomplishment (karmasiddhi) teaching for all families.
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the secret ritual accomplishment teaching of the samādhi of the rituals for all families:
"First, the general teaching on the secret ritual for the accomplishment of the samaya of all Tathāgatas' activity is as follows:
'All supreme and wondrous pleasures, such as desire and the rest, Dwell eternally within my heart.
How joyful is this gateway for benefiting sentient beings! One should know that it is taught according to circumstances, free from defilement.'"
Now, this ritual of the *karma-samādhi* is itself the *samādhi* of that Tathāgata;
by visualizing and making offerings to the Buddha, the World-Honored One, one immediately attains the accomplishment of the supreme dharma.
"This is the Dharma-gate of awakened wisdom taught by the Buddha.
The Secret Accomplishment Rite of the Ritual Samaya of the Tathāgata Family:
'I am this sublime desire, the nature of Samantabhadra, Constantly bestowing happiness upon all sentient beings.'"
Through the meditative absorption (*samādhi*) of Vajrasattva and others, one immediately attains the accomplishment of the offering rite.
This is the teaching on the sublime desire-dharma spoken by the Buddha.
Regarding the secret accomplishment doctrine of the Vajra Family’s Karma Samaya:
"This wrathful dharma of mine, Samantabhadra, brings benefit to all sentient beings;
through the ritual procedure of Vajra Trailokyavijaya, one immediately attains the accomplishment of the offering dharma."
"This is the Vajra Hand Method taught by the Buddha.
The Secret Accomplishment Doctrine of the Lotus Family Karma Samādhi:
'This nature of Samantabhadra’s wondrous love, which spontaneously attains all supreme and sublime bliss,..."
The gateway of the sublime marks that subdues the world, Through which one immediately attains the accomplishment of the Dharma of offering.
This is the Vajra-Love Dharma-gateway taught by the Buddha.
The Secret Accomplishment Doctrine of the Ratna-kula Karma-samaya:
“This sovereign nature of mine, Samantabhadra, bestows great wealth and benefit upon all sentient beings;
through this gateway of wondrous signs that accomplishes all aims, one immediately attains the accomplishment of the Dharma of offering.”
"This is the Dharma-gate of the Accomplishment of All Meanings taught by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the secret doctrine for the accomplishment of the Samaya of the Rituals (Karma) of all Families."
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the supreme siddhi-tantra of the ritual nature (*karmadharmatā*) of all families:
"First, the general explanation of the supreme siddhi-tantra of the ritual nature of all Tathāgatas:
'From the samādhi of oneself, don the armor-seal; starting from the right, proceed to the front.'"
Then, having tied the garland, one should place it upon the crown of the head; thus, one shall ultimately and constantly receive excellent protection.
This is the Dharma-gate of Enlightened Wisdom taught by the Buddha. The *Tathāgatakula-karmadharmatāsiddhi-tantra*:
"According to the ritual, one should draw upon the ground the form of the Lovely One (Sukarā) and her birth-gate;
visualizing the Lovely One as gentle and supple, one should then cause her to give rise to affection."
"This is the Vajra Hand Method taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the *Vajrakula-karmadharmatā-siddhi-śāstra*:
'One should use the tip of the fingernail of the right hand to draw the image of a yakṣa upon the ground.'"
Next, visualize striking that gateway of the eyes; this is able to summon those who are well-loved.
The *Sādhananaya* of the Lotus Family Karma-nature:
"Holding a wondrous lotus with both hands, one contemplates that the nature of desire is fundamentally pure."
By gazing with the vajra-vision upon the beloved one, one attains the manifestation of their love and respect.
This is the Dharma-gate of the Vajra-Dharma taught by the Buddha.
The *Ratnakula-karmadharmatā-siddhi-tantra*:
Abiding in the Vajraratna Samādhi, holding a vajra-gem with both hands,
and corresponding with the dharma of the syllable Ratna-hūṃ, one is able to destroy all those who are fond of worldly pleasures.
“The above constitutes the *tantra* of the accomplishment of the ritual procedures (*karmavidhi*) of all families.
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the *tantra* of the accomplishment of the activities to be performed by all families:
“First, the general *tantra* of the accomplishment of the activities to be performed by all Tathāgatas is as follows:”
"In accordance with the ritual of the offering *karma*, one should visualize whatever object is present;
by means of that very seal (*mudrā*) as the gateway of signs, the wise seeker attains accomplishment according to the Dharma."
“This is the Dharma-gate of awakening wisdom taught by the Buddha.
The *Tantra of the Rite for Accomplishing Activities of the Tathāgata Family*:
‘In accordance with the method of secret offering, one enters the samādhi of Vajrasattva.’”
"By performing whatever rites according to the ritual procedures, one will swiftly attain the accomplishment of the secret speech.
This is the Dharma-gate of Vajradhara spoken by the Buddha.
"The *Tantra of the Ritual Procedures for Accomplishing the Activities of the Vajra Family*:"
"Having performed the secret great offering of this mandala and the samādhi of the wrathful deity,
when the wise practitioner visualizes according to the specific rite, they will swiftly attain the accomplishment of the intended activity."
“This is the Vajra Wrathful Dharma-gate taught by the Buddha.
The *Padminī-kula-karmaprasarāsādhana-naya*:
‘Abiding in the Samādhi of Avalokiteśvara, one should mentally visualize making offerings.’”
When the wise practitioner contemplates according to the specific rite, they shall attain the accomplishment of all such rites.
This is the Lotus Dharma-gate taught by the Buddha.
The *Ratnakula-karmasādhanopāyatantra* (The Jewel Family’s Ritual Manual for the Accomplishment of Activities):
Abiding in the *vajragarbha-samādhi* and having performed offerings such as incense and the like,
when the wise practitioner visualizes according to the ritual requirements, they shall attain all those accomplishments in an instant.
"This is the Dharma-gate of Vajragarbha spoken by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the instructional principles for the accomplishment of activities performed by the various families.
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi proclaimed the instructional principles for the accomplishment of the visualization, mudrās, and empowerments corresponding to the various families:
"First, the general teaching on the principles for achieving accomplishment through the empowerment (*adhiṣṭhāna*) of all Tathāgatas is stated:
'By means of the application of the sublime Vajra Dharma, abiding in the yoga with the Buddha and with a mind in meditative equipoise (*samāhita*),
when the supreme *siddhi* is attained, one is an achiever of the Buddha-seal (*buddhamudrā-siddha*).'"
"This is the Dharma-gate of the Tathāgata Vajrapāṇi as taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the *Tathāgatakula-sattvādhiṣṭhāna-yogatantra-siddhinaya*:
'How marvelous! The entire body of the Sattva is universally gathered and abides within my own body. "
"I am indeed the *sattva*; through this empowerment, one should visualize my accomplishment as it truly is.
This is the Dharma-gate of Vajrasattva, the Mahāyāna Direct Realization Samādhi of all Tathāgatas, as taught by the Buddha.
*Vajrakulavajrādhiṣṭhānayogāsiddhinīti*: "Just as the *sattva-mudrā* is, so too am I; Just as the *mudrā* is, so too am I.
Through such meditative visualization (*bhāvanā*) in union, One should seek the accomplishment of all *mudrās*."
"This is the Vajradhara Dharma-gate taught by the Buddha.
Regarding the *Sādhana-nyāya* for the empowerment and application of the Lotus Family (*Padmakula*) Dharmas:
'One should visualize the subtle vajra as the application of all dharmas through the mudrās of the sublime Dharma.'"
"All are the gateways of the Speech-Mudrā; this is the Samādhi of the Great Sattva.
This is the Dharma-gate of Avalokiteśvara as taught by the Buddha.
"The Principle of the Accomplishment of the Correspondence with the Empowerment of Karma in the Ratna Family:"
"This is the empowerment rite of all Buddhas, the supreme accomplishment of the offering-samādhi;
seeking the fulfillment of vajra-karma, one should perform this visualization of the Buddha as appropriate."
"This is the Vajrakarma Dharma-gate taught by the Buddha.
The above constitutes the instructional principles for the accomplishment of the visualization, mudrās, and empowerments of all the families."
At that time, all the Tathāgatas of the world once again gathered like clouds and together praised the virtuous Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi, the Wheel-Turning Sovereign of all Tathāgatas.
The verse says:
“Excellent is Vajrasattva; excellent is the Great Vajra Jewel!
Excellent is the Vajra Gate of the Sublime Dharma; excellent is the Supreme Vajra Karma!”
One is able to skillfully proclaim this sublime Dharma, the unsurpassed Vajra Secret Vehicle,
the secret gateway of all Tathāgatas, which is subsumed within the Mahāyāna dharma of direct realization.
Chapter Twenty-Six: The Supreme Doctrine of the Ritual Manual for the True Gathering of All Tathāgatas (Part One) At that time, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Vajrapāṇi spoke these verses:
“Those with evil views and those devoid of desire are not suited to this secret dharma;
yet, for the sake of benefiting all sentient beings, I shall proclaim this teaching.”
Furthermore, Vajrapāṇi Bodhisattva Mahāsattva proclaimed the ritual procedures for the accomplishment of the activities of the various families:
"That is to say, the ritual procedures for the accomplishment of the activities of the Tathāgata family as previously explained."

Regarding the ritual procedure for accomplishing the fundamental mental activity herein: the practitioner shall first enter the great maṇḍala and observe it thoroughly; next, in accordance with the dharma, they should perform acts of offering by means of incense, flowers, lamps, and ointments while binding the respective mudrās; thereafter, they should commence the recitation with vajra-speech.

Regarding the ritual for recitation: one should dwell in accordance with the Dharma wherever one may be, completing a period of four months, performing various offerings such as incense and flowers at the four sessions each day, exactly as taught in the instructions.

Thereafter, with the one hundred and eight names of the Mahāyāna Direct Realization Samādhi of all Tathāgatas, one should recite and praise all Tathāgatas. Following those four types of ritual for prostration, one should bind the seals of the four Buddhas and, facing the four directions, prostrate to the four Tathāgatas.
